tours.shortDescription: / Cairo ,Luxor & Aswan Egypt Group Package Make of Egypt feel like real, unforgettable family time, flying in and out so there’s less h... From $2368 / Per person
tours.longDescription:
Enjoy this kind of near-perfect family break with our 10 Days Egypt Family Adventure Tour by Air , it’s made especially to blend history, a bit of adventure, and actual downtime for travelers of every age. This fun itinerary moves you through Egypt’s best-known sights while keeping things smoother, with easy domestic flights that cut down a lot of time. Start in Cairo, where your family can stare in awe at the Pyramids of Giza, the Great Sphinx, and the priceless collection inside the Egyptian Museum. You can wander around energetic neighborhood markets, and soak up Egyptian culture in a very hands-on way, then later fly south to Aswan. From there, step onto a cozy 5-star Nile Cruise, and drift along the legendary Nile River, stopping at some of the most striking ancient landmarks. You’ll have chances to tour Philae Temple, Kom Ombo Temple, Edfu Temple, Karnak Temple, and Luxor Temple, all like a slow moving storybook. In Luxor, be sure to visit the Valley of the Kings, plus the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut , where the legends of pharaohs feel oddly close and real. With family-ready lodging, professional Egyptologist guides, comfortable transfer options, and sightseeing that’s planned with care, this tour keeps a nice equilibrium between learning, enjoyment, and rest. If you’re coming with kids, teens, or even older relatives in the group , this tour package still feels right, and it’s designed to bring you an unforgettable Egyptian holiday.

Then move on to Coptic Cairo, which is still one of the oldest sections of the city. Wander the older lanes, catch sight of well-known landmarks, and just soak up the energetic atmosphere that makes Cairo one of the world’s most captivating cities. All along, you’ll travel with private transport, a professional Egyptologist guide, and a carefully planned itinerary. So it becomes a great first encounter with Cairo’s diverse past and living cultural heritage, without the usual chaos.

tours.shortDescription: High Dam & Unfinished Obelisk Visit three of Aswan’s main landmarks in just one day. You’ll visit the High Dam, take a boat to the... From $53 / Per person
tours.longDescription:
Come and experience the highlights of Aswan on this kind of enriching half-day guided tour; it’s pretty good if you like seeing things up close. Start right away at the remarkable Philae Temple, dedicated to the goddess Isis. It’s set on an island in the Nile, which honestly feels very serene. Then move on to the modern engineering marvel, the Aswan High Dam. That project reshaped Egypt’s water management and electricity supply—big changes—and you can really feel the scale. After that, you’ll head to the Unfinished Obelisk, an intriguing ancient quarry site. It gives real insight into how the ancient Egyptians worked the stone, not just in theory but in a very visible way. Altogether, this tour mixes history, culture, and engineering across different eras of Egyptian civilization, so it doesn’t feel repetitive. It’s ideal for history enthusiasts and also first-time visitors, because it bundles some of Aswan’s most important cultural landmarks into one single trip, rather neatly.

Come and discover the marvels of Upper Egypt on a 4 day Nile Cruise , starting in Aswan and ending in Luxor You’ll start in Aswan first, wandering through standout sights, and then you’ll drift north on the Nile. Stop by the splendid Temple of Philae, see the distinctive double temple at Kom Ombo, then head to Edfu for the remarkably well kept Temple of Horus. After that, you’ll glide onward to Luxor, which people often call the world’s greatest outdoor museum. In Luxor, you’ll be able to explore Karnak Temple, Luxor Temple, the Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, and also the Colossi of Memnon, yes those huge statues. During the whole cruise you can settle into comfy cabins, enjoy tasty meals, use great onboard amenities, and just watch the Nile roll by with those scenic, postcard like views. Whether you’re aiming for a romantic escape, a family break, or a deeper cultural journey, this Nile Cruise blends ease, history, and luxury in a pretty balanced way, honestly.

tours.title: 12 Days in Cairo and NileCruise and RedSea
tours.shortDescription: swan, Hurghada in Cairo and NileCruise and RedSea So you get to experience that pretty perfect mix of Egypt’s old wonders , and the coastal vibe , on... From $2172 / Per person
tours.longDescription:
Go on a 12-day Egypt holiday that feels unforgettable, because it ties together history, culture, and then, yes, a bit of calm. Start in Cairo where you can wander past the famous Pyramids of Giza, stop by the Great Sphinx, and see the highlights of the Grand Egyptian Museum. Then continue to Aswan, to jump on a luxurious 5-star Nile Cruise, cruising through the very center of ancient Egypt while you visit impressive temples and archaeological places that you don’t quite forget. You’ll also see Philae Temple, Kom Ombo Temple, Edfu Temple, Karnak Temple, Luxor Temple, the Valley of the Kings, and the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, which feels oddly personal when you’re there. After soaking up Egypts rich past, head onward to Hurghada on the Red Sea. There, crystal-clear water, lovely beaches, and top-tier resorts set you up nicely for unwinding. If you end up snorkeling or diving, or choose a desert safari, or just sit around by the sea, this trip keeps a good mix, equal parts excitement and slow relaxation.

Great Sphinx: Then we’ll see the Great Sphinx. Standing beside the Giza Pyramids. It’s the face of a pharaoh with a lion body. And it is considered one of the greatest symbols of ancient Egypt.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Grand Egyptian Museum, Coptic Cairo & Khan El Khalili
highlights: Grand Egyptian Museum: it’s the last day in Cairo before arriving in Alexandria, we’ll go to the Grand Egyptian Museum, it’s the largest archaeological museum dedicated to a single civilization. We will find Ramses II greeting us while we enter the Grand Egyptian Museum. We will discover thousands of the remarkable artifacts that tell the story of ancient Egypt, and it is the newest and the largest archaeological museum dedicated to a single civilization.

Coptic Cairo: We will visit some of Egypt's oldest churches and religious landmarks while learning about the city's rich spiritual history. It reflects centuries of Egypt's Christian history and culture.
Khan El Khalili: We’ll finish our journey at Khan Elkhalili, take your time exploring the narrow alleys and browsing Egyptian Souvenirs
Return to hotel: After this amazing day, we’ll return to your hotel, where you can relax & enjoy the rest of the evening.

Qaitbay Citadel: Then we will go to Qaitbay CitadelIt was built in the 15th century and it was built by Sultan AL-Ashraf Qaitbay . it consider one of the most important history places

itinerary.title: Day 7: Great Sand Sea Safari & Bir Wahid
highlights: Mountain of the Dead: We’ll continue our adventure at the Mountain of the Dead, an ancient hill filled with beautifully decorated rock-cut tombs dating back to the Pharaonic and Greco-Roman periods.

Great Sand Sea: we’ll set off in a 4×4 vehicle across the breathtaking Great Sand Sea. We’ll enjoy an unforgettable desert safari as you cross endless golden dunes and discover the untouched beauty of the Western Desert. It will be an amazing experience of one of Egypt’s most spectacular natural landscapes.
Sandboarding: Get ready for one of the most exciting moments of the day. You can try sandboarding down the soft golden dunes. That’s perfect for both beginners and thrill seekers.

Bir Wahid: We’ll continue into the desert to visit Bir Wahed. It’s one of Siwa’s most famous natural hot springs. It’s surrounded by golden dunes. You’ll enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of the Western Desert and relax.

tours.shortDescription: Cairo , Aswan & Luxor , Hurghada Egypt Family Adventure Come have a really good family vacation with our 15-day Egypt Family Adventure Tour. You will get to... From $2846 / Per person
tours.longDescription: Discover the magic of Egypt with our 15 Days Ultimate Egypt Family Adventure Tour, a holiday that is sort of carefully built for families who want history, culture, some proper rest, and also a bit of excitement. This journey feels unforgettable, and it blends Egypt’s most known sites with downtime on the lovely Red Sea, so it works well for travelers of every age, young and not so young. Start off in Cairo, where your family will stand face to face with the legendary Pyramids of Giza, the Great Sphinx, and you’ll wander around the Egyptian Museum to see those priceless treasures. Then take a stroll through Old Cairo’s historic lanes ,and soak in the busy feel of Khan El Khalili Bazaar, it’s lively in a way that you kinda remember for a while. After that, fly over to Aswan, where you board a deluxe 5-star Nile Cruise and drift through the very center of ancient Egypt. During the sailing you’ll visit Philae Temple, Kom Ombo Temple, Edfu Temple, Karnak Temple, Luxor Temple, the Valley of the Kings, and the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut. And yes, you’ll hear the stories from expert Egyptologist guides, so it’s not only sightseeing, it’s more like listening, learning, and then taking it all in. Then carry on with your family adventure in Hurghada, a calm Red Sea place where you can finally slow down. tours.title: 7 Days White Desert Expedition & Bahariya Oasis Tour
tours.shortDescription: a Oasis White Desert Expedition & Bahariya Oasis Tour Go on a truly remarkable seven day trek across Egypt Western Desert, it feels kinda endless in the b... From $1182 / Per person
tours.longDescription:
Slip away from the usual route and go and see the natural beauty of Egypt's Western Desert, with our 7 Days White Desert & Bahariya Oasis Safari Adventure. Honestly this is a very immersive plan, for people who want adventure, wild nature, photography vibes and those real desert moments that feel away from the crowds. It starts with a calm drive from Cairo toward the green Bahariya Oasis , where you’ll wander around old style villages, step between date palm groves, relax near natural hot springs, and visit historic places that feel almost too alive. After that, you move on by 4x4 Jeep deep into the Western Desert , to catch the volcanic scenery of the Black Desert, then you’ll see the bright quartz shapes at Crystal Mountain, and later you’ll pass through the bold views of Agabat Valley. The main moment is the famous White Desert National Park, known for surreal white limestone rock formations, carved by the wind for thousands of years. You’ll spend quiet, magical nights camping under a sky full of stars, eating tasty Bedouin food, sitting around campfires, and listening to that deep desert stillness that almost makes you forget time. Along the way you’ll notice little hidden valleys, high dunes, freshwater springs, and far away sandy places that show a side of Egypt beyond the ancient temples. With trained desert guides, comfortable transport, and well arranged nights in camp, this safari balances action, local culture, and a bit of resting too.

first up is the big one. cheops. 4500 years old. like actually think about that for a second. you get time to walk around it. take photos. do the whole tourist thing.

itinerary.description:
morning. breakfast. then we go.
guide meets you at the hotel. we drive straight to giza.
first up is the big one. cheops. 4500 years old. like actually think about that for a second. you get time to walk around it. take photos. do the whole tourist thing.
you can go inside if you want. costs extra. its tight and narrow and not great if you dont like small spaces. but some people love it. your call.
then we hit chephren. his sons pyramid. a bit smaller out of respect i guess. then mycerinus. the smallest one. from up on the plateau you get the full view of all three. sick.
camel ride is optional. but honestly when are you gonna get another chance? just do it.
sphinx next. bigger than you think. 73 meters long. carved from one piece of stone. lion body human head. just sits there. been there forever. mad.
valley temple is right in front of the sphinx. this is where they did that weird ceremony for the mummy. opening of the mouth they called it. so the dead person could eat and speak in the afterlife. wild stuff.
then we drive to memphis. about 35 mins. old capital. king menes united the country here way back when. open air museum with some proper old artifacts.
then saqqara. this place is packed with pyramids. 11 royal ones. plus mastaba tombs for the nobles. the step pyramid here is the oldest pyramid in the world. first stone building ever. imhotep designed it. legend.
we also go inside the pyramid of teti. walls covered in hieroglyphs and cartouches. then we check out one of the nobles tombs. paintings everywhere. farming. hunting. daily life stuff. colourful.
lunch at a local restaurant in saqqara village. decent food. nothing fancy but good.
then back to the hotel. youll be knackered honestly.
meals breakfast lunch

itinerary.title: Day 3: Grand Egyptian Museum, Saladin Citadel, Coptic Cairo & Khan El Khalili
highlights: Breakfast. Then we begin another exciting day in Cairo.

Grand Egyptian Museum: Our first stop will be the Grand Egyptian Museum, the newest and largest archaeological museum in the world. Discover incredible ancient artifacts, the famous treasures of King Tutankhamun, and thousands of masterpieces that tell the story of ancient Egypt in a modern and impressive setting.

Saladin Citadel: Next, we will visit the impressive Citadel of Saladin, which served as the seat of government for centuries. Inside, we'll explore the beautiful Alabaster Mosque of Mohamed Ali, one of Cairo's most recognizable landmarks.

Coptic Cairo: We continue to Old Cairo to visit the ancient Roman Fortress of Babylon, the Hanging Church, the Church of Abu Serga, where the Holy Family is believed to have stayed, and the historic Ben Ezra Synagogue.

Return to Hotel: At the end of the tour, we'll drive you back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Alexandria Road Trip
highlights: breakfast. then we hit the road.
two and a half hours to alexandria. we stop halfway for a break. stretch your legs. grab a coffee.

alexandrias a whole different vibe honestly. way more chill than cairo. feels like youre not even in egypt sometimes. like more mediterranean if that makes sense. the sea helps. alexander the great founded the place way back in like 332 bc. so its got history obviously. but it just feels different. less chaos. more sea breeze. nice change of pace.

first thing we see is pompeys pillar. big old column. built in like 297 bc which is mental when you think about it. they put it up for this emperor diocletian. apparently he crushed some revolt in alexandria and they were like hey lets build a massive pillar for the guy. standard roman stuff. its huge though. like you see it from ages away. worth a look.

then the catacombs of kom el shokkafa. discovered in 1900. one of the biggest roman burial sites. underground. kinda spooky but cool.
drive along the coast to the citadel of qaitbay. built on the ruins of the ancient lighthouse of alexandria. one of the seven wonders of the ancient world. location is insane. right at the end of a strip of land sticking out into the harbour.
bibliotheca of alexandria. modern version of the ancient library. once the biggest research centre in the world. stunning building honestly.
lunch. seafood. non negotiable. you cant come to alexandria and not eat seafood. fresh. local. by the sea.
then drive back to cairo. long day but worth it.
meals breakfast lunch.

Celebrate the start of your new life as a couple, with our 6 Days – Cairo & Alexandria Romantic Honeymoon Tour. It s made for duos who want that perfect mix of memories, heritage, and romance… you know, the kind of trip you talk about for years. You ll move through Egypt’s most recognizable sights, then land in Alexandria , that lovely Mediterranean city people often call the “Pearl of the Mediterranean.” Kick off in Cairo, where you ll be wowed by the legendary Great Pyramids of Giza, then face the imposing Great Sphinx, after that you can wander through the Grand Egyptian Museum and admire its remarkable treasures. Between all the discoveries, you get that calm seaside energy too… scenic views, romantic dinners, and relaxed walks along the Corniche, without feeling rushed or tired. And because it s a honeymoon, everything is arranged with care. You ll travel by private transportation , stay in handpicked accommodations, enjoy expert Egyptologist guides, and follow experiences that are planned with intention. So yes, it s romance, but also real rest and genuine discovery all together, smoothly done, in Egypt.

tours.longDescription:
Come and find the sweet spot between old world history and seaside vibes with this low cost 5-day Cairo and Alexandria budget tour. It’s made for people who want solid moments for a really good price, so the plan hits Egypt’s famous sights, yet still keeps things comfy with good lodging, skilled local guides and dependable transport. You start in Cairo, of course, and there you’ll wander around the legendary Pyramids of Giza, meet the Great Sphinx, and see the Grand Egyptian Museum . Before you head out, take in the lively energy of Egypt’s capital, it has that busy sparkle that’s hard to forget, then you move toward the Mediterranean city of Alexandria. Once in Alexandria, you’ll check out standout places like the Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa, Pompey’s Pillar, the Citadel of Qaitbay, and also the modern Bibliotheca Alexandrina (if the hours allow). You’ll get to know the city’s Greco-Roman background, while also enjoying that calm seaside view, the kind where the air feels different. This one fits solo travelers, couples, families, and small groups too. Overall it’s a budget-friendly route, so you still get an amazing first taste of Egypt’s history , culture and coastal charm without putting a heavy strain on your travel money.

tours.title: Pyramids, Nile Cruise & Train
tours.shortDescription: Cairo, Giza, Aswan, Kom Ombo, Edfu & Luxor, Egypt Pyramids, Nile Cruise & Train Come and feel the best of Egypt on a trip where you’ll see the Great Pyramids of Giza , plus a... From $1122 / Per person
tours.longDescription:
Explore Egypt’s most famous landmarks with this full 9 day tour bundle, kind of blending the lively pulse of Cairo, a calm Nile Cruise, and the unusual thrill of moving by overnight sleeper train. It starts up in Cairo, where you’ll see the famed Great Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx, and the remarkable exhibits at the Grand Egyptian Museum. Then you travel at night, aboard a cozy sleeper train, heading for Aswan. Once you arrive you’ll step onto a luxury Nile Cruise and quietly glide through the real center of Upper Egypt. On the cruise you’ll wander around Philae, Kom Ombo, and Edfu’s amazing temples, taking your time with every stop. After that, the journey continues to Luxor, which is basically packed with some of the world’s best archaeological finds. You’ll tour Karnak Temple, Luxor Temple, the Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, and the Colossi of Memnon, guided by seasoned Egyptologists who really know their stuff. With comfortable stays, memorable tours, scenic Nile sailing, and genuine rail travel, this trip is a solid first taste of Egypt’s ancient history, and also its living modern culture.

Come celebrate Christmas in one of the world’s most captivating destinations with this 8-day Cairo & Christmas Nile Cruise escape. So, if you like culture, festive moments, scenic sailing, and the ease of domestic flights too, this Christmas trip is a very solid choice. It’s one of those magical times of the year to experience Egypt, and really feel it.

Start in Cairo, where you will wander near the magnificent Pyramids of Giza and the Great Sphinx, also stop by the Grand Egyptian Museum, then drift into the historic lanes of Old Cairo, with its well known treasures. From there, head south into Upper Egypt, to meet Luxor and Aswan, right there by the legendary Nile River. You’ll see famed archaeological wonders like Karnak Temple and Luxor Temple, the Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, Edfu Temple, Kom Ombo Temple, Philae Temple, plus the High Dam, all while soaking in jaw dropping views as the river keeps unfolding. Everything is arranged so it feels smooth and easy—comfortable stays, knowledgeable Egyptologist guides, seamless transportation, and a sightseeing plan that is carefully mapped out. So you get that great mix of history, everyday culture, and downtime. Whether you are here the first time or you’re back for even more of Egypt’s incredible heritage, this package is set to deliver a travel moment you will not forget.

tours.shortDescription: Cairo, Sharm El Sheikh in Cairo and Sharm Come enjoy a pretty great mix of Egypt’s storied background and the amazing Red Sea on this 7-day tr... From $1358 / Per person
tours.longDescription:
Take in two of Egypt’s most liked spots with this honestly unforgettable 7 day trip that starts in Cairo, then moves to Sharm El Sheikh. You’ll begin in Cairo, and there you can wander around the legendary Pyramids of Giza , see the Great Sphinx, visit the Grand Egyptian Museum, and stroll through the old city lanes of Old Cairo. Those streets hold some really remarkable Islamic and Coptic landmarks too, so it feels a bit like stepping back in time. After that, you’ll fly over to Sharm El Sheikh on the Sinai Peninsula, a lovely resort city where the vibe is calm but never boring. Sharm is well known for crystal clear water, vivid coral gardens, and near year round sunshine. Here you can just relax on the beach, or you can swap quiet time for a few exciting optional adventures. Think snorkeling, scuba diving, boat trips heading toward Ras Mohammed National Park, desert safaris, and even Bedouin style dinners that feel both simple and special, in a good way. With ancient marvels paired with the Red Sea’s natural beauty, this getaway fits couples, families, honeymooners, and pretty much anyone who wants to see the best of Egypt in one trip that you won’t really forget.

tours.longDescription:
Celebrate Easter with one of Egypt's most complete travel experiences on this 9 Days Egypt Easter Discovery Tour Package. This private holiday combines the country's most famous historical landmarks with its breathtaking Mediterranean coastline and the magical beauty of Siwa Oasis.

Begin your Easter adventure in Cairo, where you'll explore the legendary Giza Pyramids, Saqqara, Memphis, the Grand Egyptian Museum, Coptic Cairo, and the lively Khan El Khalili Bazaar. Continue north to Alexandria, the Pearl of the Mediterranean, before following the scenic coastal road through El Alamein and Marsa Matrouh on your way to the peaceful Siwa Oasis.

In Siwa, discover the ancient Shali Fortress, the Oracle Temple of Amun, Cleopatra Spring, and enjoy an exciting 4×4 safari across the Great Sand Sea to Bir Wahid. With private transportation, expert Egyptologist guides, carefully selected accommodations, and unforgettable desert adventures, this Easter package offers the perfect balance of history, culture, relaxation, and adventure.

Great Sphinx: And we will see one of Egypt's most famous symbols. It is a lion's body with face of king . it is believed to represent King Khafre for more thousands of years

tours.shortDescription: Cairo, Aswan& Luxor Cairo & Nile Cruise by Air for Groups Come along on a not so forgettable group tour across Egypts most recognizable places. You will... From $1325 / Per person
tours.longDescription:
Come and feel the best parts of Egypt, on this thoughtfully put together 8 day Cairo and Nile cruise by Air group tour. It’s made for travel groups, so the plan mixes Egypt’s legendary old monuments with the ease of domestic flights, and also a calmer Nile River ride. You start out in Cairo, where you will see the Great Pyramids of Giza, the Great Sphinx, and the impressive Grand Egyptian Museum Then just move around Egypt’s lively capital while hearing the real stories and background from an experienced Egyptologist guide. It’s all pretty straightforward, but still feels like you’re getting inside the whole timeline. After that you’ll fly to Aswan to step aboard your deluxe Nile Cruise and travel through the core of ancient Egypt. Expect visits to Philae Temple, Kom Ombo Temple, the Temple of Horus at Edfu, plus Karnak Temple. Later there’s Luxor Temple, the Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Hatshepsut, and the Colossi of Memnon. All in all it’s a lot, but it flows, like a steady drumbeat. This is a solid choice for group travel since you get comfortable stays, guided excursions with real professionals, smooth transfers, and memories that stay with you along one of the world’s most well known rivers.

tours.title: 10 Days Egypt Group Package
tours.shortDescription: / Cairo ,Luxor & Aswan Egypt Group Package Make of Egypt feel like real, unforgettable family time, flying in and out so there’s less h... From $2368 / Per person
tours.longDescription:
Enjoy this kind of near-perfect family break with our 10 Days Egypt Family Adventure Tour by Air , it’s made especially to blend history, a bit of adventure, and actual downtime for travelers of every age. This fun itinerary moves you through Egypt’s best-known sights while keeping things smoother, with easy domestic flights that cut down a lot of time. Start in Cairo, where your family can stare in awe at the Pyramids of Giza, the Great Sphinx, and the priceless collection inside the Egyptian Museum. You can wander around energetic neighborhood markets, and soak up Egyptian culture in a very hands-on way, then later fly south to Aswan. From there, step onto a cozy 5-star Nile Cruise, and drift along the legendary Nile River, stopping at some of the most striking ancient landmarks. You’ll have chances to tour Philae Temple, Kom Ombo Temple, Edfu Temple, Karnak Temple, and Luxor Temple, all like a slow moving storybook. In Luxor, be sure to visit the Valley of the Kings, plus the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut , where the legends of pharaohs feel oddly close and real. With family-ready lodging, professional Egyptologist guides, comfortable transfer options, and sightseeing that’s planned with care, this tour keeps a nice equilibrium between learning, enjoyment, and rest. If you’re coming with kids, teens, or even older relatives in the group , this tour package still feels right, and it’s designed to bring you an unforgettable Egyptian holiday.

itinerary.title: Day 2: The Legacy of Pharaohs
highlights: Giza Pyramids: After breakfast, we’ll begin our journey with one of the world’s greatest wonders. the legendary Giza Pyramids, to see King Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure. It was built from more than 4,500 years ago.
Great Sphinx: Then we’ll see the Great Sphinx. Standing beside the Giza Pyramids. It’s a lion body with the face of a pharaoh. And it is considered one of the greatest symbols of ancient Egypt.
Saqqara: We’ll continue to Saqqara. It was designed by the architect Imhotep. And it’s the home to the famous Step Pyramid of King Djoser.

Memphis: We’ll end the day in Memphis, the first capital of ancient Egypt. The site is home to remarkable statues and archaeological remains, including the Colossal Statue of Ramses II, offering a glimpse into one of Egypt’s oldest and most important cities.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Discover the Treasures of Cairo
highlights: Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM): this day we will discover all the treasures of Cairo. We'll begin our day at the Grand Egyptian Museum, the largest archaeological museum dedicated to a single civilization. We will find Ramses II greeting us while we enter the Grand Egyptian Museum. We will discover thousands of the remarkable artifacts that tell the story of ancient Egypt, and it is the newest and the largest archaeological museum dedicated to a single civilization.

Coptic Cairo: After that we will go to Coptic Cairo. It's considered one of the oldest parts of the city. You’ll see the historic churches and religious landmarks while learning about Egypt’s rich Christian heritage and the important role this has played for centuries.

Khan El-Khalili Bazaar: No one visits Cairo without exploring Khan El-Khalili. It’s one of the oldest and the most famous markets in the Middle East. Stroll through its lively streets, discover traditional handicrafts, spices, perfumes, jewelry, and souvenirs, or simply relax with a cup of traditional Egyptian mint tea while enjoying the unique peaceful atmosphere.

Return to your hotel: After a wonderful day exploring the cultural heart of Cairo, we’ll return to your hotel to relax and get ready for tomorrow’s journey to Luxor, to start a new story in our adventure.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Journey to Luxor
highlights: Flight to Luxor: After breakfast, we’ll check out from the hotel and transfer you to Cairo International Airport for your domestic flight to Luxor. Upon arrival, our representative will be waiting to welcome you and transfer you to begin your Upper Egypt adventure.

Karnak Temple: Our first stop will be the magnificent Karnak Temple, which was dedicated to the god Amun-Ra, and it’s the largest religious complex ever built in ancient Egypt. Discover the remarkable history of the Pharos, who expanded this incredible temple over nearly 2,000 years.

Luxor Temple: We’ll continue to Luxor Temple, one of the city’s most iconic ancient monuments , it was built by Amenhotep III and later expanded by Ramses II, the temple beautifully reflects the grandeur of ancient Thebes and becomes even more impressive as the evening lights begin to shine.
Nile Cruise: We’ll board your Nile Cruise and check into your cabin. Enjoy the peaceful atmosphere as your unforgettable journey along the Nile begins.

Hatshepsut Temple: Then we visit Hatshepsut Temple. It was built for Queen Hatshepsut. It reflects the remarkable legacy of Egypt’s most successful female pharouh.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Sailing Through Ancient Egypt
highlights: Edfu Temple: We will start our adventure today at Edfu Temple. It is considered one of the best preserved temples in all of Egypt. It has remained remarkably intact for more than 2,000 years, allowing you to admire its impressive gateways, detailed carving, and magnificent halls.

Kom Ombo Temple: We will go to the unique Temple of Kom Ombo. It is located on the banks of the Nile. And it’s unlike any other temple in Egypt. It was dedicated to two gods Sobek, the crocodile god, and Horus the Elder.
Sailing to Aswan: After that we will return back to the Nile Cruise to sail toward Aswan.

highlights: Philae Temple: the first stop in Aswan will be at Philae Temple. You’ll see the amazing Philae Temple Sound and Light Show. It’s one of the highlights you’ll hear about on basically any Aswan day tour or even on an Egypt tour. It is dedicated to the goddess Isis. It’s set on an island in the Nile, which honestly feels very serene.
Aswan High Dam: It’s one of Egypt’s greatest modern engineering achievements. It built to control the Nile’s annual floods and generate hydroelectric power.

Felucca Ride: No visit to Aswan is complete without sailing on a traditional felluca. Slip away from all that city bustle and let yourself enjoy a kind of relaxing felucca sailing day on the famous Nile River around Aswan.

Nubian Village: To complete this day before return to the Nile Cruise. We’ll visit a traditional Nubian village and spend time in the colorful village to live an experience of a different side of Egypt. And meet the locals and see traditional homes. You also get to feel Nubian culture, daily life, and the way people live.

It will be an amazing experience of one of Egypt’s most spectacular natural landscapes.
Sandboarding Experience: Get ready for one of the most exciting moments of the day. You can try sandboarding down the soft golden dunes. That’s perfect for both beginners and thrill seekers.

Bedouin life: As the sun sets over the golden dunes, we’ll enjoy a Bedouin dinner under the open sky while we enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of the desert.
